Attached: 1 image

The mining rack is assembled and the P100 GPUs are here. This is the SolarAI-V2 local LLM server in assembly.

This is the hardware stack:

-Asus Z9PE-D16 motherboard
-CPU: 2x Intel Xeon E5-2620 V2 Processor
-GPU: FOUR NVIDIA Tesla P100 16GB PCIe (64GB VRAM)
-RAM: 128GB DDR3
-Storage: 120GB SSD for OS
-Storage: FOUR striped 500GB WD Velociraptor HDDs for models
-OS: ubuntu 26.04 server amd64

It will run my Hermes/Home Assistant, and is not used to generate slop.

#AI #homelab #homeassistant #llm #hermesagent #selfhosted #selfhosting
